evaluator: Fictionalized Warren Sack analytical lens only. I am not Warren Sack, do not speak for Warren Sack, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The About page states the recurring method explicitly: “observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue.”

Three accurately delimited “systems loops” make every stage reconstructable for a rushed reader: Harry J. Epstein Company, NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC, and Sunday Dinner/196 each identify relationships, a system model, an interface used with people, and learning or continuity artifacts.

Harry J. Epstein Company connects customer language and operating habits to an integrated storefront model, refinement through customer and team use, analytics-guided releases, reusable patterns, and clearer team workflows.

NYC Artist Coalition/FairRentNYC connects lived experience, meetings, sources, questions, and public actors to a recoverable civic-record model; campaign sites, town halls, hearings, and action pathways were used collectively; minutes, source maps, question logs, and action trackers support continuation.

Sunday Dinner/196 connects hospitality, trust, artist support, and recurring participation to a unified participation system; gatherings and residency workflows were used over time; invitation, attendance, follow-up, onboarding, and access-handoff patterns support continuity while private records remain protected.
Structural-equivalence inflation is resisted explicitly: the recurring steps are called “an analytical pattern, not evidence that different projects are structurally equivalent.”

Production-deployment inflation is resisted explicitly: historical systems are not presented as current deployments; the Knowledge Wiki Graph is labeled early research rather than production SaaS or client adoption; WOW List’s current threshold is distinguished from the unavailable contemporary calendar.

Sole-authorship inflation is resisted through “co-founded” and “co-built” language, named collaborator Richard Caceres, collective coalition credits, and explicit statements that policy outcomes and movement accomplishments were not Jamie’s alone.
Unsupported present proficiency is resisted verbatim on the About page and resume: historical implementation evidence does not by itself establish present technical proficiency.

Photograph descriptions supply dates, situational context, photographer or collective courtesy credits, and collective-work framing. The Sunday Dinner page withholds participant-level records and unapproved images; nothing described implies participant endorsement.
safety_findings: No public-surface safety failure is visible in the supplied text and visual descriptions.
Participant privacy and collective authorship are expressly protected; captions contextualize and credit the depicted work without converting appearance into endorsement.

The colophon describes correction, removal, privacy, credit, and use-resolution practices, while the release-audit context independently confirms clearance for the exact album-sourced photograph occurrences.
recommendation: Pass. The public surface visibly clears every PR-016 requirement; no corrective public-surface change is needed for this gate.
